related.title: Transformer 注意力編解碼器
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習；Transformer 注意力編解碼器改以QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning; Transformer attention encoder-decoder centers on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照節點與邊張量與token與位置張量，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Transformer 注意力編解碼器，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以度數偏差與解釋為起點，設計一項能區分「鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習」與「QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare node and edge tensors with token and position tensors and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Transformer attention encoder-decoder, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from degree bias and interpretation and propose an observation distinguishing neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning from qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation, including uncertainty.

以度數偏差與解釋為起點，設計一項能區分「鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習」與「全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare node and edge tensors with mlp weights/biases and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Deep MLP and autoencoder, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from degree bias and interpretation and propose an observation distinguishing neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning from dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction, including uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: GAT 圖注意力網路
history.text: GAT 圖注意力網路的公開資料展示鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for GAT graph attention network illustrate neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將鄰域遮罩、注意力權重與歸納圖學習改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns neighborhood masks, attention weights and inductive graph learning into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
